about: Proposed catalog entries for the stylizedpbr look and its ambient-occlusion pass (ChimpDuty gap modules evani-look-stylizedpbr and evani-fx-gtao, built against Evani.Dev f216906). A proposal only: Evani.Dev's catalog/*.json stays the source of truth and nothing here has been applied. The look entry keeps every existing field of catalog/looks.json 'stylizedpbr' unchanged and only adds fields; the effect entry fills the existing 'ssao' row with the GTAO implementation; the tier rows are additions for Chris to approve (catalog/tiers.json changes need his approval).

looks.json.name: Stylized PBR
looks.json.look: Vibrant colours, chunky proportions, clean physically based materials.
looks.json.render_rules: Metal-roughness PBR with simplified textures, saturated albedo, strong rim and ambient occlusion, image-based light from a small cubemap.

features.pcss: Soft shadow edges on the existing shadow map (blocker search, penumbra from the sun's angular size).
features.fur: Shells and silhouette fins on materials with extras.evani_fur, plus the baked clump map; Lite and Low draw the clump map only.
features.biplanar: Runtime biplanar tiling detail (fabric weave) on flagged materials.
features.gtao: Turns on the evani-fx 'ssao' effect (GTAO implementation) for Medium and up.

slots.rim: Soft rim, stronger on the shadowed side; look.stylizedpbr.rim and rim_width.
slots.tonemap: Filmic curve with a toe (own rational fit): authored blacks stay dark, mid-grey 0.18 maps to 0.24, highlights roll off softly.
slots.specular (new): Normalised Blinn-style lobe from roughness, Schlick Fresnel with F0 = mix(0.04, base, metal).
slots.surface_params (new): Look constants for the model shader: direct AO, environment reflections, detail.
slots.pcss_params (new, feature pcss): Light size and blocker search radius.

proposed_additions.model_maps: Reads the glTF metallicRoughnessTexture (G roughness, B metal) and occlusionTexture (R) that model.wgsl binds nothing for today; needs the evani-render 'look-surface' hook (look-surface.patch, CORE_REQUESTS-entry.md).
proposed_additions.image_based_light: Not built yet: a sky/ground hemisphere stands in for the small cubemap until the 'image-based-lighting' render-path row (Stage 5) lands.

tiers.lite: Blob shadows that also darken sky light, baked occlusion map, fur from the clump map (no shells), biplanar detail, render scale 0.65.
tiers.medium: 1024 shadow map with PCSS, GTAO 2 slices x 3 steps, 6 fur shells plus fins, biplanar detail.
tiers.high: 2048 shadow map with PCSS (16 taps), GTAO 3 slices x 4 steps, 8 fur shells plus fins, biplanar detail.

effects.json.name: Ambient occlusion
effects.json.implementation: Half-resolution SAO or GTAO-lite with a bilateral blur; baked AO when it is off.

passes: gtao.depth: half-resolution linear depth (nearest of each 2x2) plus a coarser 4x4 level for far steps
gtao.ao: horizon search in 2-3 slices per pixel with a fixed 4x4 interleaved rotation (no time term, deterministic), cosine-weighted arc integral
gtao.denoise: 3x3 depth-aware upsample multiplied into hdr; sky untouched

tiers.json (needs Chris's approval).note: Only for games whose look asks for it (stylizedpbr with feature gtao). Low and Lite keep the baked occlusion map instead.
